Hi Irene / Laura,

Thanks for the quick onboarding review last week. We need to get Kaufmann Logistics set up in Redwood's vendor portal so POs can be issued to the correct legal entity for EU shipments. Two quick points that determine how we should be onboarded:

1) We have appointed a fiscal representative in the Netherlands and have a signed authorisation (attached). The rep handles VAT filings for non-EU suppliers that want to be treated locally.
2) Our preferred PO recipient for EU sales is: Kaufmann EU BV (NL) — VAT: NL123456789B01. We also have a US parent (Kaufmann Global Inc.) but for EU transactions we need invoices/POs routed to the EU BV or processed via fiscal rep.

Could you confirm which evidence Redwood requires to accept fiscal representative invoicing (so Redwood can pay net/VAT as applicable) vs. issuing POs to our EU BV? Also please share the vendor onboarding form you need completed and the remit address you’ll use on POs.

Attachments: Kaufmann_Fiscal_Rep_Authorisation_signed.pdf (pdf), Kaufmann_VAT_Certificate_NL.pdf (pdf)

Thanks — looping finance and AP guidance. Sven, copying Ben from Tax/Compliance because there are a couple of practical PO/remittance rules you'll need to see. Our recommended onboarding flow for this scenario:

1) If you want POs and invoices processed without Redwood applying VAT reverse-charge logic, we need POs issued to Kaufmann EU BV (NL) with the VAT ID shown. That is the simplest path and supports net/gross invoicing per local rules.

2) If you prefer invoices to be issued to Kaufmann Global Inc. (US) but processed via your NL fiscal rep, we require: the signed fiscal rep authorisation (attached), the fiscal rep's registration reference, and a sample invoice showing the fiscal rep details. Finance will treat these invoices as subject to local VAT; we will need to add a PO note to route the invoice through the EU remit entity. NOTE: This path can add a 7–10 day processing check by AP for evidence and may affect timing for first payment.

Required items to complete vendor setup (please upload to the form link above):
- Signed fiscal representative authorisation (PDF)
- VAT registration certificate for Kaufmann EU BV (PDF)
- Completed vendor onboarding form (supplier bank details, remit addresses)
- If invoices will be presented via fiscal rep: sample invoice and fiscal rep registration number

I've attached an internal reference spreadsheet that shows how POs map to Redwood legal entities and the default remit addresses. Please confirm which remit you want used for POs (see "PO_entity_mapping_reference.xlsx"). Once we receive the documents we'll trigger the vendor record creation and set the PO routing flag to the EU entity.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment: PO_entity_mapping_reference.xlsx (stub)
